metadata.description: gs-claude-config as one-click Claude Code plugins: a hook-free toolkit of 42 skills, 20 slash commands, and 5 subagents, plus an optional autopilot hook you install separately.

plugins.name: gs-claude-toolkit
plugins.description: 42 skills (safe-yolo, survey-first, repo-scan, daily-summary, git-tag, quant-researcher, blender-physics-lint, and 35 more), 20 slash commands, and 5 subagents. Ships ZERO hooks — fully passive, nothing fires on your sessions.

plugins.name: gs-autopilot
plugins.description: Optional Stop-hook that powers the /autopilot skill (keep working until done / ceiling). Install ONLY if you want autopilot — it registers a Stop hook that runs every turn-end. Cross-platform Node shim, no jq.
